description: Transform any child's bedroom with a Disney frozen friendship super soft microfiber twin sheet set. This Disney Princess bedding sheet set will make any child smile. Each 3 piece, super soft microfiber twin sheet set includes a fitted sheet, flat sheet and one standard reversible pillowcase. The bold colors and exciting design will enhance the existing decor of any kid's or toddler bedroom. Fitted sheet measures 39" x 75", flat sheet measures 66" x 96" with one 20" x 26" standard pillowcase. Decorative bedding features popular characters and icons from the movie. 100percent polyester. Easy care, machine wash cold, tumble dry low. Imported
